    k = inputs['step']
    
    # Simulate the Josephus problem
    people = list(range(1, n + 1))
    current_idx = 0
    
    while len(people) > 1:
        # Count k positions (k-1 steps forward from current position)
        current_idx = (current_idx + k - 1) % len(people)
        people.pop(current_idx)
        # After removal, if we're at the end, wrap to beginning
        if current_idx >= len(people) and len(people) > 0:
            current_idx = 0
    
    return float(people[0])
